description_en: Sets user data roaming path rules for an app instance group or an app instance group set
description_zh: 为交付组或交付组集合设置用户数据漫游路径规则
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center set-user-profile-path-rules --user-profile-rule-type AppInstanceGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetUserProfilePathRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of a single app instance group. You must specify either this parameter or AppInstanceGroupSetId. If the cloud application or cloud browser app instance group belongs to an enabled set, you must configure the rules for the set
parameters.help_zh: 单个交付组 ID，与 AppInstanceGroupSetId 二选一。如果云应用或云浏览器交付组属于已启用的集合，须按集合设置规则
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of an enabled app instance group set. You must specify either this parameter or AppInstanceGroupId. You can configure rules for up to 200 member app instance groups at a time
parameters.help_zh: 处于启用状态的交付组集合 ID，与 AppInstanceGroupId 二选一。一次最多为 200 个成员交付组设置规则
parameters.name: app_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en: The JSON array string that contains the complete list of rules. Each item uses `blackPath` to specify the excluded path and `whitePaths` to specify the relative paths that still require roaming within the excluded directory. The path type `file` indicates a file, and `folder` indicates a directory
parameters.help_zh: 完整规则列表的 JSON 数组字符串。每项使用 `blackPath` 指定排除路径，使用 `whitePaths` 指定被排除目录中仍需漫游的相对路径。路径类型 `file` 表示文件，`folder` 表示目录
parameters.name: user_profile_path_rules

parameters.help_en: The type of rule to configure. Set this parameter to `AppInstanceGroup` when you configure rules for an app instance group or an app instance group set
parameters.help_zh: 设置的规则类型。为交付组或交付组集合设置规则时填写 `AppInstanceGroup`
parameters.name: user_profile_rule_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID. When you query or configure rules for a specific app instance group, specify the region where the target app instance group resides
parameters.help_zh: 请求地域 ID。查询或设置指定交付组的规则时，使用目标交付组所在地域
parameters.name: region_id
